findings.title: Certificate expired or misconfigured
findings.impact: Visitors will see certificate warnings and may abandon the transaction.
findings.recommendation: Replace the certificate and verify the chain before re-enabling the site.
findings.limitations: This should be verified against the live certificate state and local time.

findings.title: Credential harvesting redirect chain
findings.impact: The visitor may be routed into a credential capture flow after an initial trusted page.
findings.recommendation: Block the redirect chain and alert the security team for a live review.
findings.limitations: This is based on redirect semantics and may reflect a temporary change in page structure.

checks.detail: Certificate chain checks failed due to an expired leaf certificate.
Redirect analysis identified a credential capture pattern.

precautions: Avoid entering data until certificate and redirect checks are reviewed.
limitations: This assessment is based on static evidence and may not reflect live traffic conditions.
